items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He and I were kind of tight.

ctx.x: He and I were kind of tight. He always kept his little bottle with him. Always sharp. Always got a good word. Always clean. Helluva trumpet player. He played that horn til the ....(?)., right with them young cats that's blowin'. And it was a pleasure; a pleasure to know the man.
His brother was a great trumpet player, Joe Smith. I didn't know if you knew him.
